resources.string: Allow screenshots
Allows screenshots and screen recordings of protected screens.
Allow split screen
Lets the app open in split screen and bubbles.
Change package name
Installs the app under another package name, so it runs next to the original. Some apps don\'t work this way.
Package name
The new package name. Empty adds .reseam to the original.
Disable Play Store updates
Hides the app from Google Play\'s updates.
Enable debugging
Marks the app debuggable, so adb can inspect it without root.
Hide mock location
Hides that your location comes from a mock location app.
Override certificate pinning
Trusts your own certificates, so a proxy can inspect the app\'s traffic.
Block ads
Stops the app from loading ads from common ad networks.
Remove Pairip
Removes Google Play\'s automatic integrity protection. Server-side checks still apply.
Stop the Pairip VM
Only for apps whose Pairip VM does nothing but check the license. Breaks apps that run their own code in it.
Spoof installer checks
Makes leftover installer checks report Google Play.
Report Play Store as installer
Makes the app see itself as installed from Google Play.
Spoof signature
Shows the app its original signature, so checks for a modified app pass.
